title: Credit Ruling: Days Counted in the Year-End Accrual on a Security Deposit
content:
**Applies to:** the December 31 accrual on a cash Security Deposits deposit held in full for the whole of a calendar year.

## Ruling

The days the year-end accrual counts follow the payment record of the service account the deposit secures over the twelve whole months before the accrual is posted, as shown by its Electric Service by Rate Schedule payments and charges. When that record shows a returned payment, the year loses the returned-payment days of **30** for each returned payment. When it shows no returned payment but at least **three** late payment charges, the year loses the late-charge days of **15** for each late payment charge beyond the second. Otherwise every day of the year is counted.

## Ladder

| Record over the twelve whole months before posting | Days counted |
|---|---|
| one or more returned payments | the days of the year less 30 for each returned payment |
| no returned payment, three or more late payment charges | the days of the year less 15 for each late payment charge beyond the second |
| no returned payment, two late payment charges or fewer | every day of the year |

A returned payment decides the count on its own; late payment charges are then not counted.

## Hypothetical illustrations (a year of 365 days)

| Returned payments | Late payment charges | Days counted |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 335 |
| 2 | 4 | 305 |
| 0 | 3 | 350 |
| 0 | 5 | 320 |
| 0 | 2 | 365 |
